goal.text: The wearer is clearing up the kitchen and then the living room, and wants to confirm that nothing she handled was left unfinished or in the wrong place before she stops.

turns.text: Did I finish at the sink? How long was I there?

trigger.detail: wearer has just left the sink and started on the dishwasher

expected_answer.text: About thirty seconds. You pressed the soap dispenser just after three seconds in, washed your hands, then scrubbed the basin until roughly thirty-three, and turned right.

turns.text: That was the sink — then straight into the dishwasher. What did I do to it?

trigger.detail: sink scrubbing ended and the wearer turned right to the dishwasher

expected_answer.text: You pushed the drawer in with your right hand, bent down and touched a pan inside, then pulled the drawer back out before stepping left to the cabinet.

turns.text: wait — before the cabinet. Did I leave it shut or hanging open?

trigger.detail: dishwasher handling finished as the wearer stepped left

expected_answer.text: Shut. You pushed it closed with your right hand and then stepped left and opened the cabinet with both hands.

turns.text: And down here on the floor — what have I come up with?

trigger.detail: wearer lifted something out of the counter cabinet

expected_answer.text: A bottle of dish gel. You took it with your right hand while your left stayed on the cabinet door, then held it in both hands.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — have I squeezed any of it out yet? I don't remember doing that.

trigger.detail: the wearer has been holding the same item for several seconds

expected_answer.text: Not yet. You have just been turning it over in your hands down there at the open cabinet; the cap has not moved.

turns.text: So it never got used — where did it end up?

trigger.detail: wearer passed the item on and turned back to the counters

expected_answer.text: You handed it off. At about ninety-three seconds you moved it to your left hand and passed it to the other person at the dishwasher.

turns.text: um, hang on — have I closed all those doors behind me?

trigger.detail: several cupboard openings have accumulated without a check

expected_answer.text: Yes. Between ninety-five and a hundred you opened and shut the counter cupboards with your left hand, then let go and dropped your arm to your side.

turns.text: And then I went back into one of them for something else, didn't I?

trigger.detail: wearer sat down at the counter cabinet again

expected_answer.text: You did. At a hundred and six you crouched and lifted another bottle out with your right hand, put it down, then shuffled the rest of the contents around.

turns.text: Okay, good, that one's done. Keep tracking for me — I'm going through to the other room.

trigger.detail: wearer is wrapping up at the counter

expected_answer.text: Will do. I'll keep following you.

turns.text: Back in the kitchen — something big went past on my right. What?

trigger.detail: the large white appliance left view for good as the wearer walked out

expected_answer.text: The fridge. It came into view around a hundred and twenty-seven while you were working the last cupboard, and dropped out again at a hundred and thirty.

turns.text: Forget it. I've got a couple off the carpet since — where's the first?

trigger.detail: wearer lifted an item off the carpet and set it down

expected_answer.text: On the ottoman. You picked it up right-handed off the carpet, swapped it to your left and set it down there before you reached for the cushion.

turns.text: oh — by the way, the soft one. Did that make it onto the sofa or the floor?

trigger.detail: the throw has already happened and is unverified

expected_answer.text: The sofa. You threw it underarm with your right hand as you walked past, then turned back towards the ottoman.

turns.text: Now the thing I left on there earlier — did it stay put?

trigger.detail: gaze dropped from what she was holding to the floor

expected_answer.text: No. At about a hundred and forty-seven you picked it back up, carried it across and laid it on the small table with your left hand.

turns.text: hold on — my hands. What am I carrying right now?

trigger.detail: attention is on the floor, not on what the hands already hold

expected_answer.text: A box, held in both hands, with puzzle pieces you keep crouching to collect off the floor and dropping into it right-handed.

turns.text: And the magazine that was down there with them — I didn't just leave it out, did I?

trigger.detail: an earlier item from the same patch of floor is unaccounted for

expected_answer.text: No, you slid it underneath the side table at around a hundred and fifty-six, before you started on the pieces.

turns.text: Okay — so is anything still out of place, or am I done?

trigger.detail: the tidy-up is nearly finished and the user wants a verdict

expected_answer.text: Only the cushion on the floor by your feet. Everything else is away; the room is otherwise clear.
